title: An install removes ~/.claude files that main no longer ships
why: Found Nov 1 (local vs cloud audit): shiv's PC still holds a skills/tile-windows link and a plain hooks/config_report.py, neither on main. install.sh says so itself (line 593-597): proving a copy stale needs a manifest of what the last run installed, so cloud mode keeps stale copies of removed files.
note: Fix in one home: the installers (install.sh and install.ps1) write a manifest of what they installed, and the next run removes each entry main no longer ships (a link whose target is gone, or a copy it wrote). Never remove a file the install did not write: org-synced skills (the Cu... folders), request-slide, synced, tidy-downloads and the this-machine-msix-appdata rule are shiv's own and stay. Cloud lane builds and tests both shells; the Windows proof is one install on his PC. Needs no answer. Source: shiv's local audit, bridge session "Claude Code setup audit" (session_013NEJKzvTAwDAZk1K19BoZB, Nov 1 16:40 CST), against this cloud session (triage 5). Placed after guard-log-time-offset (triage 5).
